why_not_ready: D1-D5 memory-safety repairs are real, independently reproduced first-hand, demonstrated before/after and regression-locked. However one NAMED defect remains open: Stage B decide() still leaks roughly 15 allocated blocks per call, localised by systematic bisection to the source-ref ordering block but not isolated further. The commission's READY status is conditioned on real D1-D5 repairs AND demonstrations; shipping READY over an unresolved native memory leak would be a dishonest green, so PARTIAL with a named blocker is returned.

repairs_completed.D1_oob_and_truncation: REPAIRED on A and B. Exact-container admission (PyList_CheckExact/PyTuple_CheckExact) with every bound derived from PySequence_Fast_GET_SIZE of the converted sequence. Stage A ASAN went from SEGV exit 134 to clean exit 1 with no report. Silent truncation (3 supplied -> 0 admitted, sealed) is no longer reachable.
repairs_completed.D2_refcount: REPAIRED on Stage A (measured +19,999 leaked lists per 20,000 calls -> under 0.01 blocks/call). Three genuine refcount defects found and fixed in Stage B: a discarded dget probe in ref_dict_copy, a never-released dget result in exact_key_of, and an over-DECREF of borrowed relation_ref/authority_ref in mk_decision.
repairs_completed.D3_lifecycle: REPAIRED on A and B. Transactional fail_init releases the pinned TCB, classes, exception refs and partially admitted material on every fallible step. Verified: 20,000 failing constructions grow each trusted callable's refcount by at most 2.
repairs_completed.D4_module_init: REPAIRED on both modules; every PyModule_AddObject return is checked and no static reference is released twice. OOM injection NOT performed - source-justified and flagged.
repairs_completed.D5_gc_cycles: REPAIRED on both modules via Py_TPFLAGS_HAVE_GC plus tp_traverse/tp_clear over every held strong reference. No 'impossible' claim was made; a discriminating cycle construction-and-refcount test was written instead.
repairs_completed.D6_custody: REPAIRED on Stage A (scalar registry refused; real registry pinned with an owned reference and released on dealloc). Stage B verified: real snapshots pinned, non-exact snapshots refused.
repairs_completed.D7_trusted_seam: REPAIRED on Stage A: trusted_semantic_hash is now genuinely invoked at admission and re-verified at resolve, making the seam load-bearing without adding any authority. Stage B: read-only trusted_seam identity accessor added plus a test that module-attribute rebinding cannot change pinned custody.
repairs_completed.D8_payload: Stage A now detects semantic payload drift. Stage B re-verified with unchanged identity strings and a mutated payload.

named_blockers.title: Stage B decide() leaks ~15 allocated blocks per call

named_blockers.impact: bounded memory leak only; decision correctness, replay identity and custody hash remain byte-exact and the full 41-test parity court passes
